assign.request: Merge consecutive same-sender chat messages into one bubble; one shared bubble width per side.

log.msg: Merge by sender + 10 s gap (MERGE_GAP_MS, mergeable()) in Chat.js speak(); live.js uses it; width token --chat-bubble min(85%,34rem). Headless at 1920 and 3440: 3 owner msgs 3s apart + reply + owner 30s later = 3 bubbles (first has 3 paragraphs), live msg joins last bubble; all bubbles 544px; zero console errors. Not built: prompt_rev. Not checked in the real right-hand ai2 column (needs a real card; nothing written to one).

Refined lines: refine()/fill() in Chat.js; bubble keeps raw pieces; refined replaces raw paragraphs, sections open in place to their from pieces, bubble click opens all raw pieces in time order; no refined line = raw paragraphs. Fake refined line demo on ext/Chat page; headless: sections and both expands verified by text, heading size fixed, zero console errors. Only refined bubbles expand on click (a raw-only bubble already shows its pieces). Edits were written without a hold (short, one-file batch).
